Subject: Medano Health — Welcome & onboarding owners

Hi Elaine and Rajiv,

Thanks again for the time yesterday — excited to get Medano onto Redwood. Quick summary and asks to help us prepare a clean handoff to CS: 

1) Deal basics
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) + Console retention bundle
- Committed Q1 usage: ~6M tokens/month; initial go-live target: Nov 15
- Primary contact for product questions: Rajiv Menon (rajiv.m@medanohealth.com)

2) Technical notes
- Integration: SFTP push for batch transcripts (SFTP host to be provided); near-real-time API for chat features.
- Data residency: US-only (customer requires regional isolation).
- Security: customer will run our standard questionnaire; they requested SOC2 evidence and key-management notes.

3) Timeline & next steps
- Please confirm preferred kickoff slots next week (we proposed 9/14 or 9/15).
- I attached the current SOW (Medano_SOW_v1.2.pdf) and our MOP template to populate during sprint0.

Internal note for CS: there may be custom batching and KV-cache tuning needed for the streaming chat workload — estimate 1.5x onboarding effort.

Elaine / Rajiv — can you confirm the procurement lead (for redlines) and whether security will need a test environment early? Also confirm the technical contact for SFTP credentials.

Attachments: [Attachment: Medano_SOW_v1.2.pdf (application/pdf)], [Attachment: MOP-template.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen

Thanks Stephanie — excited to move forward. A few quick items from our side: 

- Procurement: please loop in procurement@medanohealth.com for SOW redlines; they aim to finish review within 7 business days once they have the latest SOW.
- Security: our security team will run your questionnaire — planning to kick that off 9/13. They will want SOC2 artifacts and the KMS/HSM integration notes you mentioned.
- Environment: we do want a staging instance accessible from our VPC (VPC peering request will follow from our infra team).

Kickoff: 9/15 at 10am PT works best for Elaine and me. Please share a draft agenda + attendee list.

One more ask: we use an internal tag for the deal (MED-926) — can you include that on all deliverables?
